findings.reader: A tight, well-bounded daily news brief that reports the Bloomberg/Reuters 38-gigawatt roadmap with attribution intact, teaches the capacity-versus-energy distinction in plain language, covers the AI-specific versus general cloud split, and explicitly marks what the report cannot establish. Explain-back and a fresh transfer scenario both succeed on the article's mechanism alone.
findings.facts: All four material claims verify against the supplied Reuters and Bloomberg Law excerpts with attribution, approximations, and scope limits faithfully retained. Dates make the reporting reviewable, the paywall limitation is honoured by scoping the facility-scope claim to the public excerpt, and uncertainty (reported plan, no Microsoft confirmation, unknown future utilization) survives into the article's conclusions.
